added_cases.mapping: both. MC29 is the time-of-use rule: a configuration that changes after the cohort's preflight (its setup bound the selection and wrote the manifest) invalidates the current attempt with zero starts, and the case is named under MC29. Section 1's rule decides the rest: every document of the 0.2.0 provider is /0.2.0, and the entry points of each version refuse the other version's documents, so a 0.2.0 cohort is accounted only by the 0.2.0 accounting and no 0.1.0 document may enter it. Section 10 sets the labels that its refusal records. MC29 alone says nothing about which version accounts the cohort, and section 1 alone says nothing about the change at time of use; the finding needs both.
